## Not added

A 30-vehicle supercar, luxury, and muscle lineup was not downloaded. Free Sketchfab, Kenney, and Quaternius catalogs do not include 30 realistic, commercially licensed, brand-safe vehicles with distinct silhouettes. Ripped or unclear-license models were rejected. Existing save ids were not removed.
